lines.en: label dormwarssix1:
scene noonsky
I’ve found myself in a familiar place today.

But I suppose that’s nothing new when my life’s become nothing but a series of blasé routines that, more often than not, end with me praying to the God of Infertility to work Their magic on whoever it was I just came inside of.

But in making this joke I realize that I might actually be contracted to such an entity through means I am presently unaware of, so my morning monologue is now more mysterious and less whimsical than I’d have liked.
That’s probably for the best, though. Our “team” is growing after all. And pretty soon, we might be able to get enough people on the rooftop to cause some sort of collapse that somehow saves us all.
It’s a shot in the dark, sure. But what isn’t these days?
It does make me wonder about the endgame here, though.
If we do get to a point where everyone’s just...aware of where we are (or when we are), could there be some sort of harmony?
A way for us to live and...
Well, that’s it.
Just live.
It sounds like Hell to me, honestly.
Especially now that I’m more determined than ever to put an actual end to all of this rather than some hypothetical one that would ultimately result in me having a seemingly infinite amount of sex.

Turns out even those who love their job get tired of working after so long. Which means my endless pursuit of a thing called happiness can rear its ugly face again and crawl through the windows into my room.
Let it smother me while everyone outside does all the work. Because I’m beginning to think that is the only way I’ll ever feel it at all.
But even then, as its metaphorical hips gyrate to extract more subconscious pleasure out of my symbolic phallus, I’m not sure I’ll be able to accept or understand it.
Because being here, face to face with one man’s Heaven, has done little to prove to me that I should stop thinking of death so much.
And if not even this makeshift afterlife can save me, it must mean that my “peace” requires something more fluid.
Something that keeps moving instead of just sitting in the corner of the room and growing under the light of the sun and the occasional squeeze of a bottle to help keep it wet.
All it does is make me think of the end even more. Accept that not accepting it does little to help my fear of it one day claiming me.
: LET’S FUCKING GOOOOOOOOOOO! DORM WAAAAAARS!
I suppose that fear hasn’t come for Uta yet, though.
scene dormwarssix1
: IT’S MY MOST RELEVANT TIME OF THE YEAR AGAIN!
: Yo, if you’re gonna shout out curse words like that, at least keep the volume low enough that everybody in the class next door doesn’t hear it too.
: I’LL CONSIDER IT!
As you can see, learning that we’re caught in an infinite loop of her high school years has done little to affect her mood. In fact, I might even wager that she’s in a better mood lately.
But that might just be on account of now being able to overlook the timeline she thought she had to win my affection despite already having done that.
: Hey. Shut up.
Makoto’s the same too, as you can see.
scene dormwarssix2
: Sorry, Makocchi. I’ll be good. I promise. You can go ahead and read off all of our contests now.
: Wait, no! Senpai doesn’t stop in very often anymore and I have to formally introduce him to make him feel welcome before we do anything else!
: I’ve been here for an hour, Imani. I’ve already talked to everyone.
: Okay, but I was on lunch and missed out on all of that. At least let me shout really excitedly?
: Fine. Go.
scene dormwarssix3
: MY BOY IS BAAAAAACK IN CLASS! YEAAAAAAAAHHH!
scene dormwarssix4
: For today.
: NOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
: And also tomorrow if we wind up coming back here since knocking out the Dorm Wars in one day would piss off everyone looking forward to the inevitable sleepover.
: You mean Ayane?
: Yes, I mean Ayane.
scene dormwarssix5
: I’m Ayane. What’s going on? I zoned out.
: Sleepovers.
scene dormwarssix6
: Oh, I love those.
: That’s exactly what they were saying.
scene dormwarssix7
: Since when do you pay attention to anything that’s said in class?
: Since the guy saying it became the same guy I’ve had copious amounts of rough sex with. Now, watch as I maintain eye contact to guilt him into wanting me and only me again.
: Good luck. I think that’s why Noriko’s eyes always look the way they do and that hasn’t worked for her yet.
scene dormwarssix8
: Good point. Maybe I just need to open mine wider.
: Yeah, that’ll do it for sure.
: Sensei! And also Imani-sensei! I propose that we just start the Dorm Wars tomorrow and that we get a head start on the sleepover right now!
: Dump your stupid fake girlfriend and love me, you pathetic idol-fucking predator.
scene dormwarssix9
: Maya, stop doing that thing with your eyes. You’re starting to look like Chika ever since we announced that Niki would be making an appearance this year.
Why do I feel so drawn to her all of a sudden?
: Also, we need to do this now or it’ll make me look bad. I managed to score us a half-day while every other class has to stick around until the last bell rings.
: Does that also explain what the TV crew is doing here again? Or were you guys also planning on starting some sort of school-based reality show?
scene dormwarssix10
: Our interviews and the first couple contests are being broadcast to the rest of the school. They don’t stop rolling until we go over to Chika’s place later.
: Yeah, y’all should probably just, like...not do that. Chika clearly ain’t fit to host right now.
scene dormwarssix11
: Well, Chika’s going to have to figure that out as soon as possible because she’s competing today as well.
scene dormwarssix12
: And given that this year’s competition once again involves Sensei as a prize and not just bragging rights, there are nine other girls counting on her to win.
: Don’t lump me in with them if you know what’s good for you, Prez.
: Stop being such a tsundere and admit you love him already, Yumi. We all know it.
: Wha- no?! No, I don’t! The fuck are you talkin’ about?!
: Yeah, what gives?! Yumi loves me! Onii-chan’s just my greatest rival.
: That ain’t true either! You guys are fuckin’-
: Blah, blah, blah. Drama, drama, drama. Everyone in this room including Miss Imai wants to win Sensei and so we should just bypass all of this small talk and get down to brass tacks. We-
: Now, hol’ up. Does that mean I can also win him if there’s a tie or something?
scene dormwarssix13
: I...guess that seems fair to me. Uta?
: No. I win him if there’s a tie.
scene dormwarssix14
: That seems less fair to me. Why?
: Because I deserve him, obviously.
: In what scenario does Miss Imai win him then?
: There isn’t one. I win no matter what because I am the queen of Dorm Wars. It’s the new rule.
: Yeah, I’m going to have to reject this proposal. In the event of a tie, Miss Imai is now going to be the winner.
: WOOO! OBJECTIFICATION! I MIGHT WIN A MAN!
scene dormwarssix15
: You’ll pay for this when the apocalypse comes, Makocchi...
: If this is somehow the thing that manages to smite me after all this time, so be it.
scene dormwarssix16
: In the meantime, though, let’s recap. All contests this year were chosen via audience poll, so please don’t be mad at us if you don’t like what you received.
: Competition one — Athletics Abound. A fitness test pitting...me...up against Nodoka. Again. I have never been less excited for anything in my life.
scene dormwarssix17
: Ah. So the audience went with the sabotage route instead of choosing people who might be good at stuff. Got it.
: Competition two — Chaotic Cooking Class. Self explanatory. We’ll have Chika compete against Noriko for that one.
scene dormwarssix18
: Wait, but they’re both good at that. Are we not doing the whole sabotage thing after all? Let me read the next.
: Competition three — Familial Face Off. You can’t choose your family, but...imagine you could? Ami vs. Otoha. Two only-children.
scene dormwarssix19
: Or...only childs? Which is correct there?
scene dormwarssix20
: Competition four — Drawing With Nao-chan. Because we are apparently roping actual children into the Dorm Wars now. Wonderful. Maya vs Yasu. Two people who are very good with children, I’m sure.
: After that, the final competition of the day will be a new flash dating version of the fan favorite Date War where each girl will only have ten minutes to prove their worth.
scene dormwarssix21
: In which I finally get a chance to shine by showing off my flirting skills against Rin, who can’t flirt to save her life!
: H-Hey! I’ve technically had the most girlfriends out of anyone in this class!
: I think I’m also technically winning then.
: Makoto, be my girlfriend for the next thirty seconds so Rin stops bragging.
: Fine.
scene dormwarssix22
: Wait, no! You weren’t supposed to agree! I don’t want you to be my first!
: Fine. Then I’m breaking up with you.
scene dormwarssix23
: AND NOW I’VE BEEN DUMPED!!! THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE MY TIME TO SHINE!
: After Rin ultimately fails considering this year’s Date War will not involve Sensei at the behest of Miss Imai-
: Wait, what?!
: Sucks to suck, girl. I ain’t about to let y’all date an adult on my watch.
: BUT YOU LET ME DO IT LITERALLY LAST YEAR!
: Yeah, cause I know you and Io ain’t got the balls to do anything. You really think I’m gonna let Uta be alone in a room with Senpai in her current state?
: MY BODY IS EXPERIENCING CHAAAANGEEEEES!

: So, as I was saying, after Rin ultimately fails considering this year’s Date War will not involve Sensei and will, instead, involve a mystery guest, we’ll head to the hotel and prepare for tomorrow.
: But for now, I’ll pass things over to our field reporter, Molly MacCormack, who must stall for the next twenty seconds while the rest of us run downstairs for our pre-game interviews.
scene dormwarssix24
: Top o’ the mornin’ to ya! Molly MacCormack here! Reporting live from just outside of Kumon-mi High! And boy, do we have a show in store for you this year!
scene dormwarssix25
: Joining me now are Futaba Fukuyama and Nodoka Nagasawa — two girls who were very insistent on being out here beforehand so they would not have to run with the rest of the class.

: But something I’m sure all the viewers at home are wondering is how exactly you expect to win your athletics competition with literally no drive to exercise at all, Nodoka. What do you have to say to that?

: Apologies for the inconvenience, but I am only here to touch my friend. And I do not intend to win the athletics competition as I was put on this planet for one purpose and one purpose only — convincing Futaba that she is a lesbian.
: And what do you have to say to that, Futaba? Is it working?
: No.
: Alas. It appears I must try even harder...
scene dormwarssix26
: Ah! And would you look at this?! It seems that Touka’s joined us before we even had the chance to mention her competition against Futaba here.
: It’s easy to forget just how athletic I am when I excel in virtually everything. I have a lot of practice moving downstairs given the size of my family’s home.
: I guess I’ll be glad you and I aren’t competing in the first contest then, Touka.
: Yes. And might I say, I’m quite excited to be competing against you this year, Futaba.
scene dormwarssix27
: Now, for those who don’t already know, Futaba and Touka-
scene dormwarssix28
: Hello. I am also here now.
: Ah! So quick! Could it be that Makoto’s competitive spirit has given her the drive needed to excel in a competition where the odds are stacked against her?!
: I wouldn’t say they’re stacked against her at all. In fact, I’d go so far as to say she has an advantage given all of the...cardio she’s done with our “prize” prior to this year.
scene dormwarssix29
: Cardio?
: Why, yes. My rigorous training routine with Sensei has most certainly prepared me to wipe the floor with you, Nodoka. I hope you’re looking forward to it.
: Oh, I can assure you I am. In fact, there are few things I’d like more than having you drag me across a dirty floor to mop up the residue of your exercise routine.
: Disgusting. Just call your maid.
: Now, without getting sidetracked any further, we do still need to hear from Futaba and Touka about their teaching competition.
: Because, from what I can remember, you actually wanted to be a teacher once upon a time. Didn’t you, Futaba?
: Uhh...not really. You’re probably thinking of Makoto.
scene dormwarssix30
: Oh...well...my apologies if that is the case. I clearly need to do a little more research on our contestants.
: It’s fine. Just because I don’t want to be a teacher doesn’t mean I’m not going to give it my all tomorrow. I just hope I’m able to keep my composure the way Touka certainly will.
: Being judged by our teachers adds to the pressure, for sure. But, honestly, I don’t think there’s much they know that I don’t. So my strategy will be just doing what I wish people would do for me.
: Well, I won’t pretend to be as smart as you or anything like that, but I’m not going to just roll over either. May the best girl win, Touka.
: I’d say the same to Nodoka but, honestly, I would rather just destroy her once we make it to the park.
scene dormwarssix31
: Come to think of it, though, we should probably head there now. I’d like to get changed so I don’t have to run around in a skirt.
: Five more minutes. I’m still trying to convert my beloved sister here so that we may one day cross the boundaries that all adolescent girls are meant to in order to find themselves.
: Well, unfortunately for our viewers, you’re going to have to do that off-screen since there are still a ton of interviews we need to get to!
scene dormwarssix32
: Before we do that, though, I’d like to tell you a little more about today’s sponsor — Rocket Money!
scene dormwarssix33
: Do you like money? Well, so does the moon!
: So put all of your money in a giant rocket and send it there so they can build an Arby’s for when we’re all forced to evacuate the planet. Thank you.
scene dormwarssix34
: That is not what Rocket Money is, Molly.
: Ahh, but it could be! Just like how you could be the winner of tomorrow’s trivia contest against Io Ichimonji! How do you plead?!
: Guilty. And so I hereby grant myself a life sentence to loving my future husband, Akira Arakawa. Congratulations to Io on her win and apologies to Ami for her loss.
: And what do you have to add to that, Io?
: Nothing. Don’t talk to me. This is stupid and I’m only doing it because Otoha dragged me here.
: Just only minimally acknowledge her existence. I’ve found that’s really the best way to handle Io.
scene dormwarssix35
: And what an excellent- wait! Cool camera angle shift! I'm sure that was some sort of artistic choice and not just a mistake at all!

: But, as I was saying, what an excellent skill that deciphering such things might be! Because being family means being attentive to one another’s needs! And if Otoha can do that later today, Ami could be in trouble!
: It’s definitely going to be weird competing in some sort of “family” contest that doesn’t involve my dad. I still imagine I have the upper hand, though.
: I imagine you do as well. Because, from what I understand, one of the judges is going to be Chika’s sister. And Chika isn’t exactly my biggest fan, so...
: I don’t think Chika’s really much of anything right now, to be honest. She’s too focused on when Niki’s going to show up.
: Did you hear that, viewers? The Niki Nakayama will be making an appearance at this year’s Dorm Wars! But how could she not when she’s already gone public about her love for our very own teacher?!

: Which is why we’ve decided to call this year’s Dorm Wars the “Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars: Round 6 ~ A Competition That Definitely Does Not Exist so Twenty High School Girls Can Have an Excuse to Pursue the Boyfriend of a Famous Idol That They All Love and Admire!”
: These titles are getting fucking ridiculous.
scene dormwarssix36
: They sure are! But the entire concept of twenty heroines duking it out for the love of a grown man is ridiculous! So we do what we can! Don’t we, girls?!
: For anyone watching us inside or outside of the school right now, I, Ami Arakawa, would like to formally confirm that I am romantically interested in my father.

: And I am saying this to dispel all rumors about me and label this information as factual. Please send any and all fan-art or fan-fiction of us together to my email address: arakawaami@kumonmihigh.edu.
: Or you could ship him with the slightly more socially acceptable Ayane Amamiya — a girl who he only kind of raised and isn’t related to by blood. Amamiyaayane@kumonmihigh.edu.
: Please don’t send me anything. I hate checking my email.
: And I hate this. Goodbye.
scene dormwarssix37
: We probably should have brought Uta along for Io’s segment, huh?
: Oh man...competing against her tomorrow is going to be weird. She definitely does not like me.
: Well, yeah. She likes a total of like three people and I imagine all of us but Otoha are at, like...the very bottom of that list.
: Regardless of who likes who, we’re just thirty minutes from our official start time now! So we need to get the heck outta Falador and let our brand new field reporter, Miku Maruyama, take over!
scene dormwarssix38
: Thank you, Molly! And thank you to Rocket Money as well for building an Arby’s on the moon! My name’s Miku Maruyama and I’m here to expand my portfolio to include journalism as well!
: Why am I trying to expand my portfolio, you ask? I don’t know! But that doesn’t matter now because I’ve got a bunch of girls with me who are going to do some stuff to hopefully win a man-slave!
scene dormwarssix39
: Maya! What would you do with a man-slave?
: I don’t think I can say it on camera, unfortunately.
: And how about you, Sana?
: I’m ready and willing to say it on camera. I just probably shouldn’t at the risk of getting somebody in trouble.

: If I had a slave, I would chain him to the third-most marble pillar in the House of God and glue his feet to the stone floor so that he could never escape the light that slips in through the cracks in the ceiling and ultimately bleaches him with love and devotion to all things pure.
: And I’d probably just ask him to cook for me and hold my hand since I’m a good girl now.
: You ain’t foolin’ nobody, Kirin.
scene dormwarssix40
: But, thankfully, you won’t have to! Since your contest this year involves bein’ a barista and I’m pretty sure that’s another word for wrestling!
: Baristas make coffee. That’s what Rin and Molly are.
: That remains to be seen! And sounds like a pretty boring contest to me. I think we should make ‘em wrestle instead. Don’t you agree, viewers?!
: I mean...it would definitely take the advantage Sana has away. Doesn’t she help out at her mom’s bar? How different can that be from making coffee?
: Very when you take into account that there are nineteen different ways to brew coffee. At least that I’m aware of.
: Oh, good. So I just need to learn one of them. Fun.
: I’m also open to wrestling instead if...that’s what you’d prefer. Starting on equal footing is...probably the best for the sanctity of the competition.
scene dormwarssix41

: A surprising outlook from the shortest girl in class! Has somethin’ changed about your outlook recently, Sana? Cause I kinda figured you’d wanna take any advantage possible if it meant winnin’ Sensei.
: I’m going to win him regardless of this competition’s outcome...so anything is fine, really...
scene dormwarssix42
: Oh. So you are my enemy as well now. Good to know.
: Ya know, Maya, your real enemy is Yasu. And from what I’ve heard, you actually ain’t half bad when it comes to strokin’ the pen.
: Oh, sorry. I thought there were more letters coming. Yes, I can draw. But this contest involves me being in the presence of a child, to which I refuse to even feign excitement.
: That said, Yasu will likely win because I imagine I’ll be disqualified for violence.
: I hate violence. And I love children! They are much easier to convince and convert.
scene dormwarssix43

: Right! Well, I’ve clearly lost control of this group of contestants, so I’d like to take this opportunity to welcome our next batch of gals who will hopefully be a little more emotionally competent!
scene dormwarssix44
: Yup! That’ll do it.
: Girl.

: Girl, indeed! And I’m sure we both know which “girl” you’re talkin’ about, Chika. So tell me, as the alleged number one fan of Noriko’s sister, how excited are you to see her on a scale of one to ten?
scene dormwarssix45
: Girl.
: Is it just me or should we be, like...actually worried about her right now?
: I think it’s...probably fine? My sister does have this sort of effect on girls. And Chika’s already encountered her once, so I imagine there’s some lingering admiration still floating around.
: Then, as the sister of this famous idol who I ain’t ever really listened to, what can you tell us about how she’s going to “participate” this year, Noriko?
: Nothing. I’m under NDA. And Nee-chan isn’t really talking to me lately based on “recent transgressions of mine.”
: So what I’m hearin’ is that you’re gonna destroy your opponent in the cooking competition?
: Now, I don’t have the best hearing either, but I’m not really sure how that’s what you got out of literally anything I just said.
: I imagine Miku just picked up on the confidence I’m exuding knowing I am going to dominate Rin later!
scene dormwarssix46
: Hot.
: No, like...uhh...
: Weird. I always thought of you as more of a bottom.
scene dormwarssix47
: I am! N...Not like that matters, though! I just meant in the...contest! I get paid to flirt with people and you’re historically bad at that!
: I don’t know, Uta. You seem like the flustered one right now. Who’s to say that won’t happen during the competition?
scene dormwarssix48
: Th...That’s just because you haven’t factored in my secret weapon yet. I’m still in regular Uta mode. And so long as I’m able to suppress that during the contest, Rin is as good as dead.
: I’m just trying not to think about the competition, honestly.
: I’ve learned through experience that no amount of preparation actually helps me when it comes to stuff like this and that I kinda just need to vibe in order to succeed in literally anything.
: Girl.
scene dormwarssix49
: Yes, Chika. Girl. Very good. Now try to say “Rin” next. Or “Chika.” Or literally anything else to show us that you’re still in there somewhere and not just a zombie now.
: Girl.

: You heard it here first, folks! And while some of ya might think it’s bad that we’re televisin’ some innocent girl’s descent into madness, that’s exactly the kinda thing ya need to expect from the Dorm Wars!
scene dormwarssix50
: Before we let our sponsors take it away, though, there is one more thing we’ve gotta address!
scene dormwarssix51
: And it’s that your beloved field reporters will be takin’ part in our own contests as well!
: That’s right, people! So tomorrow, you can look forward to me learnin’ how to act by puttin’ on my own play thingy over at Sara’s place!
: And you can look forward to me failing miserably at some sort of obstacle course since I, too, am allergic to physical activity! Much like many of you out there!
: So stay tuned and stay...I don’t know! Some other word that starts with T!
: Terrible!
: Yeah! You guys suck! Which is why you’re all still inside while we get to hang out here and have fun!
: Tsuneyo also begins with the letter T.
: Be quiet. I think they forgot about us.
: We’ll be back soon after a quick message from our sponsors!
$ dormwarssix1 = True
